annotations.title: Safe Inspect: owners and threshold in one call

description: [Kyreos, 0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base] One paid call reads a contract's Safe owners, threshold, nonce, version and master copy. Limits: Ethereum only, and the chain input is ignored. is_safe:true means the contract gave Safe-shaped getOwners and getThreshold answers; it does not mean a verified Safe. is_safe:false needs two RPC endpoints to agree. If they cannot confirm an answer, the call returns an error, not is_safe:false. Input: {"address":"0x52e66Fa0b0CCdE7a945E7eD7409A43593ED32886"}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/safe-inspect?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.01 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.01 USDC on Base)
